description: Golden test queries for the store finder. Expected values are computed from the store files in this folder.

response_status_rules.ok: every item matched, available and routed
response_status_rules.partial: at least one item is unavailable or not found; the rest are routed if possible
response_status_rules.needs_clarification: at least one item is ambiguous; the shopper must choose
response_status_rules.error: input rejected or not a product request

how_to_check.matched: chosen SKU must be one of acceptable_skus
how_to_check.ambiguous: status must be ambiguous; 2 to 3 options, all inside acceptable_skus
how_to_check.route: total_cost must equal the expected value (within 0.01); the visiting order must have the same total cost; floor_changes and connectors_used must match
how_to_check.start: start is a landmark name that resolves to start_node in the route; when start_floor is present the label exists on both floors and the floor picks the point
